purpose: Simulated Mi 1:10 and Ce 10:1 mixtures with equal per-worm two-ligand total release

protocol.noise: none; deterministic design points, not independent experimental replicates
protocol.stage_role: Stage labels define intended density units; release rates use equal two-ligand total, not a cross-stage empirical comparison

release_assumptions.absolute_scale: Each release rate is common Q times an assumed composition fraction; no absolute release measurement anchors Q.

target.source_support: Qualitative ascaroside profiles include ascr18 secretion in plant-parasitic nematodes; the target ascr3:ascr18 composition of 1:10 is assumed.
target.ascr3_condition: Meloidogyne incognita ascr3 secretion is unconfirmed.

background.source_support: Caenorhabditis elegans produces both ligands; the ascr3:ascr18 composition of 10:1 is assumed.

normalization.Q_status: arbitrary common simulation scale; not a measured rate
normalization.fraction_status: assumed ratios, not quantified literature spectra
normalization.rule: equal per worm per hour, not equal per sample; concentration retains worm abundance
